title: Reliable Milos home tap
details: Tapping the Milos face now uses a direct pointer/touch handler instead of relying only on the delegated click route
The home menu opens through the existing Milos avatar action so no second menu system is introduced
The offline shell is bumped to 2.33 so installed PWAs cannot keep the non-working 2.32 interaction layer
All Milos 2.31 video evidence, witness export, calendar and standard UI improvements are retained
